Master virtual

Experience seamless automated admissions
management with HirePro. From student
registration and payments to assessments,
interviews, ranking, counseling, seat allocation, and
enrollment, our system ensures efficiency for both
applicants and staff. Our advanced auto-proctored
remote assessments protect against cheating,
ensuring admission to your institution for
high-caliber, integrity-driven students.
Power online training and certification
Digitisation of learning and content is a continuous trend. HirePro enables effective
technology-driven virtual classrooms in low-bandwidth settings, offering tools for efficient and fair program delivery and evaluation. Our platform automates the entire process from student registration to certification, giving you the flexibility to provide self-paced, adaptable, and enriching digital learning experiences for uninterrupted education.
Success story
More than 160 million users worldwide trust
Pearson products and services. The latest version
of Pearson’s Versant - a language testing solution is
powered by HirePro. Our innovative AI technology
facilitates the monitoring and recording of test
sessions through automated online proctoring,
providing comprehensive evaluations of
candidates' language skills and competencies at
your convenience, anytime and anywhere.
